name: plan
description: Turn a promoted PM intent into a technical plan for AI agents — /plan-create runs the ready gate and locks the intent with lock.yaml in the-marmack/intents (pinned to its commit), picks the the-marmack repo where the work belongs, and breaks the intent into small ordered tasks with acceptance criteria traced to the intent, published as a draft pull request in the intent's folder in the-marmack/intents; /plan-review loads a plan PR so reviewers can ask it questions (read-only).
